rules.text: Refunds for in-store purchases are made using the same payment method used for the purchase.
rules.quote: If you have returned an item purchased in-store, the refund will be made with the same method of payment used for the purchase.

rules.text: If refund to the original payment method is not possible for in-store returns, store staff will provide an alternative method.
rules.quote: If a refund to the original method of payment is not possible, our store staff will indicate an alternative method.

rules.text: Refunds for online purchases are made using the same payment method used for the purchase.
rules.quote: When you make a return of an online purchase, you will receive the refund via the same payment method you used for the purchase.

rules.text: Online returns sent through a shipping company are processed within 72 hours after receipt at the facilities.
rules.quote: If you sent your return through a shipping company, we will process it in the 72 hours after receiving it in our facilities.

rules.text: Refund amount will be received within a maximum of 14 days after return completion, depending on the bank.
rules.quote: Keep in mind that once the return has been made, you will receive the amount within a maximum period of 14 days, depending on your bank.
